[Intro]
I'm

[Verse 1]
[G]sitting in the railway station. Got a
[G/F#]ticket to my destination.
[G/F]
[Em]
[Am]On a tour of onenight stands my
[F]suitcase and guitar in hand. And
[G]every stop is neatly planned for a
[Dadd11/A]poet and a oneman band.

[Chorus]
[G]Homeward
[C]bound, I wish I
[G]was, Homeward
[C]bound,
[G]Home where my thought's [F][G/D][Am]escaping, [Em]
[G]Home where my [G/D][Am]music's [Em][F]playing,
[G]Home where my love [Am]lies [Em][G/D][F]waiting
[D]Silently for
[G]me.

[Verse 2]
[G]Every day's an endless stream Of
[G/F#]cigarettes and magazines.
[G/F]
[Em]And
[Am]each town looks the same to me, the
[F]movies and the factories And
[G]every stranger's face I see reminds
[Dadd11/A]me that I long to be,

[Chorus]
[G]Homeward
[C]bound, I wish I
[G]was, Homeward
[C]bound,
[G]Home where my thought's [F][G/D][Am]escaping, [Em]
[G]Home where my [G/D][Am]music's [Em][F]playing,
[G]Home where my love [Am]lies [Em][G/D][F]waiting
[D]Silently for
[G]me. To-

[Verse 3]
[G]night I'll sing my songs again, I'll
[G/F#]play the game and pretend.
[G/F]
[Em]But
[Am]all my words come back to me in
[F]shades of mediocrity Like
[G]emptiness in harmony I
[Dadd11/A]need someone to comfort me.

[Chorus]
[G]Homeward
[C]bound, I wish I
[G]was, Homeward
[C]bound,
[G]Home where my thought's [F][G/D][Am]escaping, [Em]
[G]Home where my [G/D][Am]music's [Em][F]playing,
[G]Home where my love [Am]lies [Em][G/D][F]waiting

[Outro]
[D]Silently for
[G]me.
[G/F#]Silently for
[G/F]me.
[G]
title: Homeward Bound
tuning: E A D G B E
